On the Premium user retrieval benchmark, Holistic-171 gets an **ACC of 0.794** and a **MAR@25 of 0.169** (Table 1, page 7).

- **ACC** checks whether the clicked candidate gets the highest score among 4 candidates (1 positive and 3 negatives). Random chance would score 0.25 (page 7).
- **MAR@k** checks whether clicked candidates rank in the top k of a fixed pool of 100 candidates. All models use the same pool (page 7).
- Holistic-171 is LinkedIn's production general-purpose member embedding. It has 171 dimensions and is trained on several LinkedIn engagement objectives using profile and behavioral signals (page 7).

**Context:** Holistic-171 beats the off-the-shelf 0.6B embedding (ACC 0.771, MAR@25 0.100). It scores well below the best PAIR model with P-ATT history (ACC 0.967, MAR@25 0.265) (Table 1, page 7).
